tier2.text: INVENTED FIXTURE - Three makers supply most of this class of industrial pump: Example Manufacturing at 28 percent of units sold, Pump Makers Corp at 24 percent and Valve Industries at 11 percent, with the rest split among about 40 regional builders. Example wins re-orders on its service network - 42 depots against Pump Makers Corp's 19 - because a stopped pump costs a mine more per day than the pump itself. A utility that buys nothing keeps its existing units and rebuilds them on a seven-year cycle, and every bid is priced against that alternative.
